review_candidates.title: Senior Pre-Sales Solutions Engineer - Europe
review_candidates.description: Job Description Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. Note: this is a remote role that is to be based out of one of the following countries: United Kingdom Ireland Scotland Switzerland Opportunity Deepgram is expanding globally and operating a follow-the-sun model. We are hiring a Pre-sales Solutions Engineer in EMEA to win complex technical evaluations, design clear solution paths, and drive repeatable adoption for strategic accounts. Our strategic Account Executives do not hand off their customers after the first sale, so you will partner long-term across discovery, POC, production launch, and expansion. You will focus on pre-sales, yet you will often step into post-sales style work when the stakes are high and continuity matters. About Applied Engineering At Deepgram Applied Engineering blends what many companies split into Solutions Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Solutions Consulting, and Technical Support. We are builders and communicators who bridge sales and engineering. We help customers move from problem to production with speed, clarity, and measurable outcomes. What You’ll Do Lead technical discovery for strategic opportunities. Map business goals to measurable technical success criteria and an evaluation plan. Design, scope, and execute POCs that prove value. Define datasets, metrics, and timelines that land a clear technical win. Build lightweight prototypes, sample integrations, and demos using Deepgram SDKs and APIs. Show, do not tell. Advise on architecture for accuracy, latency, scalability, and cost. Cover cloud, self-hosted, hybrid, and data residency needs. Run security and compliance threads common in EMEA. Prepare crisp responses for GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and vendor risk reviews. Triage and debug issues during evaluations. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Support to unblock customers quickly. Create reusable assets that scale. Turn repeated requests into working samples, reference architectures, runbooks, and field guides. Partner with Solutions Architects and Support for seamless continuity after initial wins. Stay involved through expansion phases when needed. Enable the field. Collaborate with AEs, CSMs, and partners on positioning, demos, and technical validation for priority use cases. Regional Expectations Based in an EMEA time zone with strong overlap to customer business hours. Excellent written and spoken English. Additional European languages are a strong plus. Familiarity with procurement, InfoSec, and data privacy expectations across EMEA, including GDPR and data residency. Your First 90 Days In the first weeks you will pick up low-risk customer tickets to learn our systems and support flow, then progress to pre-sales escalations tied to active opportunities and engagements driven by Account Executives or partners. First 30 days Ramp on Deepgram’s product surface area, platform APIs, SDKs, evaluation methodology, and security review materials. Shadow strategic discovery and POC calls. Triage and resolve low-risk tickets with a Solutions Architect or Support partner. Focus on reproductions, log and trace collection, SDK setup issues, and clear notes and handoffs. Publish one internal field guide that clarifies a common EMEA pre-sales topic (for example data residency, telephony capture, or evaluation metrics). By day 60 Own two evaluations end to end with defined success criteria and timelines. Serve as the named technical partner for one or two strategic AEs. Run weekly technical deal reviews and prepare objection handling packs. Take point on higher signal tickets related to your evaluations, coordinating fast fixes with Product, Engineering, and Support. Deliver one live demo that becomes a reusable asset for the region. Pair with a Solutions Architect on a production launch to learn handoffs and escalation paths. By day 90 Act as the primary pre-sales technical owner for several opportunities and expansions within strategic accounts. Close at least one complex technical win with a measurable impact on revenue. Lead one customer architecture workshop that documents a reference plan for production rollout or expansion. Convert repeated ticket patterns into a runbook, sample, or accelerator and present a short readout on the impact. You Will Thrive Here If You Enjoy the mix of customer conversations and hands-on building. Can move from whiteboard to working code and back without losing the thread. Communicate clearly with executives and deeply with engineers. Value speed with rigor and crisp documentation. Like winning together across regions and functions. Minimum Qualifications 5 or more years in Solutions Engineering or a similar customer-facing technical role focused on pre-sales. Professional software engineering experience in at least one language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or Rust. You can build POCs and tools that real users run. Hands-on experience with modern cloud platforms. Comfortable with Docker, Kubernetes, networking fundamentals, and secure API design. Proven track record leading POCs for enterprise customers and earning the technical win. Clear written and verbal communication across both technical and executive audiences. Preferred Qualifications Experience with speech recognition, TTS, voice quality analysis, or AI agents that orchestrate LLMs. Familiarity with telephony and real-time media concepts such as SIP, WebRTC, streaming, and WebSocket integrations. Experience with self-hosted and hybrid deployments, including Helm-based installs and production observability. Strong understanding of authentication, authorization, and data residency topics that appear in EMEA enterprise reviews. Fluency in an additional European language such as German, French, Dutch, Italian, or Spanish. How We Work Remote across EMEA with periodic regional meetups. Close partnership with AEs, SAs, Product, and Engineering to support continuous coverage across EMEA, the Americas, and APAC. Shared playbooks, defined escalation paths, and measurable SLAs. Interview Process Recruiter screen focused on experience, motivations, and logistics. Hiring manager conversation focused on technical depth and customer impact. Practical assessment that mirrors real work. Expect discovery, solution design, and a short hands-on exercise. Panel interviews with cross-functional partners. Simulated pre-sales engagement based on a case study, along with and architecture walkthrough of a past technical win. Show your approach to success criteria, trade offs, and outcomes. Notice: We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

With the backing of experienced investors, we're building Ramp for Banks: a modern, AI-powered spend management platform for expenses, corporate cards and payables that banks offer to their business clients. It's a multi-billion-dollar global market, and with our product, customer base and bank partnerships, we're well positioned to win it. How we build Our engineering team is AI-native. Every day we use AI coding tools to design, write, test and ship software. We need engineers who are fluent in vibe coding. That means you can direct AI agents to move fast, and you have the engineering judgment to review, harden and own what goes to production. About you: We're looking for senior engineers who want a real challenge and a chance to shape what comes next. You'll join ExpensePoint at a turning point: we're rebuilding our platform, modernizing our stack and going after a much larger market. On a small, high-impact team, you'll solve hard problems, own major features end to end and see your work in production from day one. If you like fast change, constant learning and leaving a lasting mark, we want you on our journey. Why you'll love it Immediate impact and visibility: your work reports directly to our Engineering Manager, with designs reviewed by our Principal Engineer, and will have high visibility to the CEO and other senior management. No bureaucracy: we're small and lean, and we take ownership and get things done. Meaningful ownership: you'll lead features end to end in a culture with lots of feedback and high accountability. Growth culture: we play hard, work hard and learn by doing. Expect plenty of mentorship and fast skill growth. Flexibility and rewards: fully remote, flexible hours and generous benefits. Competitive salary in USD. What you'll do Architect and build: design scalable microservices, RESTful APIs and rich web and mobile clients. Build AI-first: use AI coding agents every day, and help set the team's standards for building with them. Own and deliver: take features from concept through production and monitoring. Champion quality: set best practices for CI/CD, test coverage, documentation and observability, which matter even more when much of the code is AI-assisted. Ship AI in the product: apply the latest AI and ML techniques to real customer problems, from automated expense review to smarter spend controls. Mentor: guide mid-level and junior engineers through code reviews, pairing and tech talks. Must-have 5+ years as a professional software engineer. Fluent in vibe coding: you use AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot every day to ship production software, and you know how to check what they produce. Proficient in one or more compiled languages (C/C++, C#, Java, Go, Kotlin, Swift, Rust) or interpreted languages (JavaScript, Python, Ruby). Hands-on experience with CI/CD tools (Travis CI, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions). Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP). Strong RDBMS skills and RESTful API design. B.Sc. in Computer Science (or equivalent). Nice-to-have Front-end: React, React Native, Next.js, Vue, Angular. Back-end: Node.js, Spring, .NET, Rails, messaging systems (Kafka, Kinesis). NoSQL experience (MongoDB, DynamoDB). Experience building or scaling large applications. Experience with containers (Docker, Kubernetes). ExpensePoint is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and believe ownership and accountability drive success, for you and for us. Join us to redefine how businesses and their banks manage spend. If this sounds interesting, please send your resume and a sample of your work to jobs@expensepoint.com.

review_candidates.description: Senior Software Engineer Osprey Flight Solutions · Full-time · Remote, home-based · Reports to Head of Engineering Why this role, why now Aviation security teams and airline operators make real decisions off what Osprey's platform tells them, so the software behind it has to be right. Support what's already live: investigate and resolve support desk issues within SLA, and own contained pockets of technical debt, escalating the harder cases to technical leadership. Give informed estimates on everything from fully scoped work to raw ideas, and flag blockers early rather than sitting on them. Help shape what gets built next, contributing to PRDs, technical feasibility testing and prototyping during discovery. Design solutions that fit Osprey's reference architecture, and take the more complex proposals to the technical design authority. Break work into small, shippable pieces with your team, and take planned production changes through change management, so you can show you release safely. Pension : Osprey matches your contribution at 4% of gross basic salary (on top of your own 4%) via the Smart Pension scheme, with an optional salary sacrifice arrangement that saves on National Insurance for both sides. Other perks: Cycle to Work scheme, an eyecare contribution through the AXA plan, professional membership and subscription fees paid where relevant to the role, and a £1,500 referral bonus once the person you refer completes probation.
